requiredView.title: Set up invoicing before using the POS
requiredView.description: To open tables, charge or close sales, the restaurant needs to connect its Moloni account and choose the fiscal series for Invoice, Simplified Invoice and Credit Note.

settingsView.title: Moloni integration
settingsView.incompleteWarningDescription: To activate the POS, you need to set up the invoice, simplified invoice and credit note series.
settingsView.setupTitle: Connect Moloni to issue legal invoices
settingsView.setupDescription: MesaLink uses Moloni to issue certified invoices, simplified invoices, credit notes, fiscal QR codes and SAF-T. Once set up, you can issue documents directly from the POS.

step1.title: 1. Create a Moloni account
step1.text: Create or access the restaurant's Moloni account.

step2.title: 2. Create fiscal series
step2.text: In Moloni, create series for Invoice, Simplified Invoice and Credit Note.

step3.title: 3. Communicate series to the tax authority
step3.text: Series must be communicated/active before issuing real documents.

step4.title: 4. Connect to MesaLink
step4.text: Once connected, choose the series on this page and save.

settingsView.importantDescription: While Moloni isn't set up, the POS can run in experimental mode, but shouldn't be used for legal invoicing.
settingsView.seriesSectionDescription: To activate the POS in live mode, choose the Moloni series used for Invoice, Simplified Invoice and Credit Note.
settingsView.recommendationTitle: Moloni ON is enough to get started
settingsView.recommendationDescription: We recommend the Moloni ON plan to use invoicing integrated with MesaLink. It includes API, SAF-T, series communication to the tax authority, customers, items and fiscal documents. If you need more documents or features, you can upgrade directly on Moloni.

noSeriesSteps.step3: 3. Create/communicate the series to the tax authority
noSeriesSteps.step4: 4. Come back to MesaLink and save the series

documentsView.title: Fiscal documents
documentsView.description: All certified invoicing is managed directly in Moloni. Use this page only as a quick guide for invoices, credit notes and SAF-T.
documentsView.moloniCardDescription: View invoices, issue credit notes and export the SAF-T directly from the restaurant's Moloni account.
documentsView.importantInfoDescription: Issued invoices shouldn't be deleted. If there's a mistake, a Credit Note should be issued, followed by a new, correct invoice.
